question: Identify all cards illustrated by 'Jim Pavelec' that either have a white border or are banned in at least one format. For these cards, retrieve their Italian name (if available), indicate whether they carry a content warning, and whether they appear in a starter deck. Only include cards that have an Italian translation.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    fd.XCL_079 AS italian_name,
    CASE WHEN c.XCL_064 IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS content_warning,
    CASE WHEN c.XCL_029 = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS starter_deck
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN foreign_data fd
    ON fd.XCL_082 = c.XCL_072
   AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Italian'
WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Jim Pavelec'
  AND (
        c.XCL_005 = 'white'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM legalities l
            WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
              AND l.XCL_085 = 'Banned'
        )
      )
